content: Patience can cook a stone until it becomes soft and sweet.
author: African Proverbs
sourceWork: Hankuri na dafa dutse — Hausa Proverb (Nigeria/Niger)
explanation: To human eyes, a granite stone in a boiling pot will never soften. Yet in the poetic hyperbole of the savanna, the Hausa declare that patient devotion to the fire can transform even the most stubborn, unyielding circumstance. There is no trial that does not yield to steadfast endurance.
practicalInsight: Keep tending the quiet fire of effort beneath that stubborn problem today. Do not abandon the pot.
reflectionPrompt: What situation in your life feels as hard as a stone, and can you bring unhurried patience to it?
